name: aw-motion
description: Promo videos for ActivityWatch, rendered from canvas pages with headless Chrome

scripts.day: node day-music.js && node render.js activitywatch-day.mp4 --page day.html --audio day-music.wav
scripts.real: node real-music.js && node render.js activitywatch-real-ui.mp4 --page real.html --audio real-music.wav
scripts.real-dark: node real-music.js && node render.js activitywatch-real-ui-dark.mp4 --page real-dark.html --audio real-music.wav
scripts.tour: node tour-music.js && node render.js activitywatch-tour.mp4 --page tour.html --audio tour-music.wav
